## Notes

Covers AI content shipped to players, not development-efficiency tools. Pre-Generated content reviewed like other content; Live-Generated content must also describe guardrails against illegal output. Live-generated AI adult-only sexual content not permitted. Lists ways to fund ongoing AI service costs (base price, microtransactions, subscription, DLC).
